jsx-a11y/alt-text.why: production passes elements/img/object/area lists rather than defaults, so the fixture checks the option is read as well as the rule running

jsx-a11y/anchor-has-content.why: enabled bare in production; empty <a /> is the only shape it matches

jsx-a11y/anchor-is-valid.why: production adds components: [Link] and specialLink: [to]; the fixture carries a Link control so a dropped option shows up as an extra finding

jsx-a11y/aria-activedescendant-has-tabin.why: enabled bare in production; aria-activedescendant on a non-interactive div with no tabIndex

jsx-a11y/aria-props.why: enabled bare in production; aria-labeledby is the misspelling that is not an ARIA attribute

jsx-a11y/aria-proptypes.why: enabled bare in production; aria-hidden="yes" is outside the boolean enum

jsx-a11y/aria-role.why: production sets ignoreNonDOM: false; role="buttons" is not in aria-query's role set

jsx-a11y/aria-unsupported-elements.why: enabled bare in production; <meta> is an element ARIA cannot be applied to

jsx-a11y/control-has-associated-label.why: production's ignoreElements excludes input and textarea, so the violation is an empty <button> and the control exercises labelAttributes: [label]

jsx-a11y/heading-has-content.why: production passes components: [""] (the default list plus an empty entry); an empty <h2 /> is what it matches

jsx-a11y/html-has-lang.why: enabled bare in production; lang="" is the shape both engines read as absent -- a bare <html> makes oxlint's lang fire too, lang={null} makes ESLint's fire too

jsx-a11y/iframe-has-title.why: enabled bare in production; <iframe> with no title

jsx-a11y/img-redundant-alt.why: enabled bare in production; alt text that repeats the word photo is redundant to a screen reader

jsx-a11y/label-has-associated-control.why: production asserts "either" htmlFor or a nested control; a bare <label> has neither

jsx-a11y/lang.why: enabled bare in production; two findings because both lang="foo" and the empty lang in HtmlHasLang are invalid language tags, and the empty string is the only missing-lang shape neither engine handles alone

jsx-a11y/media-has-caption.why: production empties the audio/video/track component lists, leaving the plain DOM elements to flag; <video> with no captions track

jsx-a11y/interactive-supports-focus.why: enabled bare in production; role="button" without tabIndex is not focusable

jsx-a11y/mouse-events-have-key-events.why: enabled bare in production; onMouseOver with no onFocus. oxlint splits this rule in two (click-events-have-key-events is separate), so the anchor is the interesting part

jsx-a11y/no-access-key.why: enabled bare in production; accessKey duplicates the tab sequence

jsx-a11y/no-autofocus.why: production sets ignoreNonDOM: true, which only excuses components; autoFocus on a DOM <input> still reports

jsx-a11y/no-distracting-elements.why: production lists marquee and blink explicitly; <marquee> is the first

jsx-a11y/no-interactive-element-to-nonin.why: production allows tr to take none/presentation and nothing else, so <button role="presentation"> is the violation

jsx-a11y/no-noninteractive-element-inter.why: production lists the handler names explicitly; onClick on a heading (non-interactive implicit role) is the violation

jsx-a11y/no-noninteractive-element-to-in.why:
production allow-lists ul/menu and ol/menu;

is outside it and the ul control proves the allow-list is read

jsx-a11y/no-noninteractive-tabindex.why: production allow-lists the tabpanel role and no extra tags; tabIndex on a plain div is the violation, the tabpanel control the exception

jsx-a11y/no-redundant-roles.why: enabled bare in production; <ul role="list"> restates the implicit role

jsx-a11y/no-static-element-interactions.why: production lists the handler names explicitly; onClick on a role-less div is the violation

jsx-a11y/role-has-required-aria-props.why: enabled bare in production; role="checkbox" requires aria-checked

jsx-a11y/role-supports-aria-props.why: enabled bare in production; aria-sort belongs to columnheader, not to the checkbox role carrying it

jsx-a11y/scope.why: enabled bare in production; scope outside th/td/tr is meaningless

jsx-a11y/tabindex-no-positive.why: enabled bare in production; tabIndex={3} on a button, so no-noninteractive-tabindex stays out of this rule's count
